 CORRESP 
 
 
 

 
 

 123 South Front Street, Memphis, TN 38103 Phone (901) 495-6500 

 April 3, 2017 

 United States Securities and Exchange Commission

 Attn: Yong Kim, Staff Accountant 

 Division of Corporation
Finance 

 Washington, D.C. 20549 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 RE: 
 
 AutoZone, Inc.

 Form 10-K for Fiscal Year
Ended August 27, 2016

 Filed October 24, 2016

 File No.
1-10714

 

 Dear Ms. Kim: 

 I
am in receipt of the letter dated March 22, 2017 (the Comment Letter) of the staff of the Division of Corporation Finance of the United States Securities and Exchange Commission concerning AutoZone, Inc.s (the Company)
Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended August 27, 2016 that was filed on October 24, 2016, under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. 

 Per your telephone conversation with the Company on April 3, 2017, I am writing to confirm that the Company will file its response to the
Comment Letter no later than April 12, 2017. Should you have any questions regarding this matter please do not hesitate to contact me at (901) 495-7024. 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 
 Sincerely, 

 
 
 

 
 By: 
 
 /s/ WILLIAM T. GILES 

 
 
 
 William T. Giles

 Chief Financial
Officer and Executive Vice President

 Finance and Information Technology
